name: electron_demo
description: Minimal Electron demo app for CI packaging validation

scripts.build:tsc:check: npm run typecheck:main && npm run typecheck:preload && npm run typecheck:renderer
scripts.build:all: npm run build:tsc && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:tsc:check && npm run build:all && npm run smoke-test
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:prod && node scripts/run-electron-builder.js --linux --x64 --publish never && npm run package:smoke-test
scripts.build:linux:dir: npm run build:prod && node scripts/run-electron-builder.js --linux dir --x64 --publish never && npm run package:smoke-test:dir
scripts.build:win: npm run build:prod && node scripts/run-electron-builder.js --win --x64 --publish never && npm run package:smoke-test
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:prod && node scripts/run-electron-builder.js --mac --publish never && npm run package:smoke-test
scripts.build:mac:x64: npm run build:prod && node scripts/run-electron-builder.js --mac --x64 --publish never && npm run package:smoke-test
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run build:prod && node scripts/run-electron-builder.js --mac --arm64 --publish never && npm run package:smoke-test
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:36598 file:dist/preload/index.mjs file:dist/main/bootstrap.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.dev: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('dist'))fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && concurrently -k "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:preload" "npm run dev:electron"
